text: Ghamorz is an Orsimer miner who works in the Mor Khazgur Mine in the Orc stronghold of Mor Khazgur in Haafingar hold. If anything is stolen from his mine, hired thugs will come after the perpetrator.
Gathal Llethri is a Dunmer Knight a House Father of House Hlaalu. He can be found in the guard house on the Dren Plantation.
Gemellus Axius is an Imperial in the Imperial City and the manservant of Jakben, Earl of Imbel.
Gerich Senarel is an Imperial guard found outside Castle Bruma.
Geem Jasaiin is an Argonian who has come to Imperial City from Black Marsh to work. He can be found in his house in the Elven Gardens District or wandering the streets.
Gavesu Arelas is a Dunmer warrior who resides in Sargon. He is hostile and will attack on-sight.
Gelduin is a Bosmer Hunter residing in Tel Mora, Morrowind. She is a member of House Telvanni.
Geilir the Mumbling is a Nord seer who lives in his dwelling in the Isinfier Plains on the island of Solstheim.

Geldis Sadri is the Dunmeri landlord of The Retching Netch cornerclub in Raven Rock. He sells food and drink, including Ashfire Mead, rents rooms for ten and, like bartenders elsewhere, is a good source of rumors.
General Falx Carius is an Imperial found in Fort Frostmoth, located on the island of Solstheim. He is the antagonist of the quest "March of the Dead."
Gee-Pop Varis is a Dunmer gardener who cared for the plant life in the Temple Courtyard in Mournhold, where he can be encountered. He is the husband of Granny Varis and father to Trels Varis.
Gavas Drin is a Dunmer priest who may be found in the Office of the Lord Archcanon in Mournhold's Temple. He is a Patriarch and thus the Archcanon of the Tribunal Temple in Mournhold.
Gavis Velas is a Dunmer mage who lives in Velas Manor in Godsreach, with his brother Ovis.
Ghamonk gro-Agadbu is an Orsimer barbarian who resides in the slave cave of Zebabi.
Ghamborz gro-Bagdub is an Orsimer Barbarian who resides within Yansirramus near the shrine to Molag Bal. Located within the region of Azura's Coast in Morrowind.
Geilund is a Nord who lives in Bleakrock Village. He is the husband of Halmaera and master of Rexus.

Gathwen is a Bosmer who comes running for help near the Temple of the Mourning Springs. She and her master, Rurelion, were shipwrecked, so they came to the temple when they heard that the water never ran dry—referring to the Mourning Stone.
Gervaise is a Redguard clothier who resides in the city of Daggerfall. She can be found west of the Daggerfall Cathedral. Gervaise appears to be in a state of duress.
Geon Stental is a Breton tailor residing in Aldcroft, Glenumbra. He has a stall at the Lionguard Camp Market where he sells his wares.
Gfvod Lodorrsbane is a champion of the Hall of the Dead public dungeon. Killing this creature counts towards the "Champion of the Hall of the Dead" and "Slayer Of The Hall of the Dead" achievements.

Geonard Stogrin is a Breton pack merchant found in the city of Wayrest, Stormhaven. He sells packs at his stall, Stogrin's Satchels, in the Wayrest Treasury. He sells the Vestige upgrades to their inventory space.
Gerethel is a Bosmer residing in Elden Root in the region of Grahtwood.
Gerinien is a Bosmer residing in Elden Root in the region of Grahtwood.
Gelvin Feldrin is a Breton in , first found in the Shrieking Scar, High Rock and the brother of Granette Feldrin. He is the founder and leader of the mercenary group known as The Daggers.
Genboril is Bosmer residing in Elden Root in the region of Grahtwood.
Genriel is a Bosmer beggar residing in Elden Root in the region of Grahtwood.
General Mandin is a Breton general in the Lion Guard found at the Lion Guard Redoubt, Glenumbra, in . She is trapped inside the Lion Guard Siege Camp with her soldiers.

General Yeveth Noramil is a Dunmer and member of the Great Moot, the ruling body of the Ebonheart Pact, during the Three Banners War. He is also found nearby the Honrich Tower Wayshrine, during the quest, Shattered Hopes.
Georges Ancois is a Breton residing in Koeglin Village, Stormhaven. He can be found working at a small farm with Charloux Rarnis next to the Koeglin Village Guild Traders.
Geric is a Breton residing in Bad Man's Hallows, Glenumbra. He is found praying near the large tree.
Gelem is a Breton residing in Alcaire Castle, Stormhaven. He's found near Dame Falhut's House.

General Thoda is a Redguard residing in the Alik'r Camp outside Alcaire Castle, in Stormhaven. He's found in the house that has become his home. He's Nimaima's husband. Thoda is one of King Fahara'jad's most trusted advisors.
Ghamarguk gra-Ugrush is an Orsimer residing in Wayrest, Stormhaven. She can be seen walking around the northern part of the city.
Gerielle Gidric is a Breton residing in Wayrest in Stormhaven. She is an enchanter and can be found in the Chironasium, close to the Wayrest Mages Guild.
Gerrick is an Altmer in . He owns the store Gerrick's Goods. He owns a parrot named Orsone that, when talked to, can reveal the whereabouts of hidden treasure.

General Duvais is a Nord general in . He leads Skyrim's forces against Hammerfell in the War of Bend'r-Mahk, and is besieging Dragonstar. He tries to establish a foot-hold in the Loth'Na Caverns to the west, and the player's choices determine his success. He holds a shadowkey.
General Serien is a Breton located in Fort Virak, Stonefalls. He is the enemy of both the Vestige and the Ebonheart Pact that the Fort belongs to.
Gelana Hlan is a Dunmer student found in the Guild Plaza of Mournhold, right outside of the city's resident Fighters Guild branch.
Gelii Hlaalu is a Dunmer merchant of House Hlaalu. She sells her wares at her stall, House Hlaalu Assured Wares, in the Royal Bazaar of Mournhold.
Gendyn Beleth is a Dunmer working at the Artisans Craftworks in Mournhold.
Gavric Cadiou is a Breton blacksmith residing in the city of Evermore. He can be found at the Evermore Smithy, selling his wares.
Gavrard Dechery is a Breton stablemaster residing in the city of Evermore.
General Marenil is an Altmer member of the Aldmeri Dominion residing in the Western Elsweyr Gate in Cyrodiil.
General Gavryn Redoran is a Dunmer of House Redoran and a member of the Ebonheart Pact. He is the commanding officer of Tal'Deic Fortress.
Genthel is a Bosmer residing in the city of Skywatch. She is a member of the city guard.
Geralda Armene is a Breton residing in the town of Dragonstar. She cannot be interacted with.
General Jeggord is a Nord officer of the Ebonheart Pact stationed at the Northern Morrowind Gate.

General Dar-Liurz is an Argonian general in the Northern Morrowind Gate. Dar-Liurz rewards the player after completing quests to kill enemy players and scouting missions on enemy keeps and resources, obtained from the two quest boards flanking her.
Geford is a Nord patron of the Silver Moons Inn at the Baandari Trading Post.

General Khamagash is an Orsimer general in the Covenant army, and is the second-in-command to Grand Warlord Dortene along with General Am-Shadal. According to the note on his desk, General Khamash has lost a number of troops on scouting missions.

General Am-Shadal is a Redguard general in the Covenant army, and one of the generals under Grand Warlord Dortene, the other being General Khamagash. He is found at the Southern High Rock Gate, in the Colovian Highlands. In a response to a recent outburst by General Khamagash, Grand Warlord Dotrene urged General Am-Shadal to encourage Covenant soldiers to travel in groups as opposed to doing so alone.
General Brilnosu is a Dunmer and high-ranking member of the Maulborn Cult found in Eidolon's Hollow.
Gedric Serre is a Breton residing in the city of Wayrest. He is under the employ of the Pellingare Family as a private guard.
General Nala is a Redguard member of the Daggerfall Covenant residing in the city of Wayrest.
General Stelanie is a Breton member of the Daggerfall Covenant. He is found inside the castle in the city of Wayrest.
General Thoron is a Bosmer general in the Eastern Elsweyr Gate.
General Atahba is a high-ranking Khajiit officer of the Aldmeri Dominion. She oversees operations at the Eastern Elsweyr Gate.
Gelds Indoril is a Dunmer member of House Indoril and the Ebonheart Pact residing in Fort Amol. He acts as the ambassador of the Dunmer people at the meeting taking place at the fort.
Gerrald Chriane is a Breton brewer residing in the city of Shornhelm.
Gerbert Lateur is a Breton residing in the town of Wind Keep.
Gathers-Dead-Things is an Argonian residing in the city of Windhelm.
Gerbert Pirouet is a Breton residing in the city of Windhelm.
Geraud Maviniele is a Breton residing in the city of Windhelm.
Gerdur Wealdwalker is a Nord woodworker who can be found selling her wares at the Tree's Bounty in Windhelm.
Gathiel is a Bosmer found in Karthdar. She is the wife of Eranas.
Gathotar is a Nord researcher conducting experiments on an amulet purposely crafted to protect the wearer from the powerful lightning attacks of the Wamasus, harvesting the lightning's magicka.
Geeh-Dooka is an Argonian alchemist in who is found in Bleakrock Village.
Geeh-Sakka is an Argonian guild trader part of the group of outlaws found beneath Stormhold.
Gefvid Lodorrsbane is a powerful Draugr found in the Hall of the Dead underneath Windhelm. In life, he was one of the warriors who brought the Necromancer Lodorr to justice.
Geirilda is a Nord merchant selling her wares at The Practical Traveler in Jorunn's Stand.

Geirvarda Frostwind is a Nord mage found at the Mournhold docks. She was originally from Lower Yorgrim, where her family lived. As no one in her family but her possesses any magical abilities, she can be persuaded to give up her invitation to Shad Astula.

Gelthior is a Bosmer and the cousin of King Camoran Aeradan. He was the founder and leader of the original Blacksap Rebellion, but he was captured by the Vinedusk Rangers. In present day, his sons Gorinir and Lorchon, are attempting to revive the movement.

Gena Omarys is a Dunmer fisherman found at the Bal Foyen Dockyards. She attempted to tame a local Nix-Hound with the help of her flute but was attacked by the latter. She was saved by another hound and thus has adopted it.
Gendinora is a sickly Bosmer found in Northsalt Village. She gets her medecine from her brother Nedras, who turned to the Bitterhand Bandits and banditry to pay for it.
General Bathes-In-Blood is an Argonian high-ranking member of the Ebonheart Pact found at the Southern Morrowind Gate.
General Braning is a Nord officer of the Ebonheart Pact who is currently stationed at the Southern Morrowind Gate, on the Cyrodiil-Morrowind border.

General Dathieu was one of King Ranser's most trusted advisors during King Ranser's War. During his last stand, he was the one who slain him after he realized Ranser was going mad. The King, filled with anger after being betrayed by his general, returned as a vengeful skeleton and killed Dathieu for his "treason."
General Elaric was a Breton in and member of the Alessian Order present during the battle of Glenumbra Moors.
General Elirwen is a Bosmer member of the Fighters Guild found in the hall of Velyn Harbor.
General Emax is a Breton general of the Daggerfall Covenant leading the attack on Fort Zeren.
General Endare is an Altmer general of the Aldmeri Dominion conducting excavations at the Falinesti Winter Site.
General Godrun is an Orsimer general of the Daggerfall Covenant and the current leader of the Murtag Clan. He and his clan are currently fighting the Ironhand Ogres at Shinji's Scarp.
General Ivandi is a Nord member of the Fighters Guild. He is found at their guildhall in Riften.
General Lauran was a Breton in and general of the Alessian Order present during the battle of the Glenumbra Moors.
General Lavinia is an Imperial officer in charge of the Legion of the West Weald. She leads the forces who took over Arenthia.
General Quintilius is an Imperial soldier encountered during Khali's vision. He is the one responsible for the slaying of her mother.
General Radrathren is a Chimer ghost found in the Starved Plain, Stonefalls.
General Nesh-Tan is an Argonian general of the Ebonheart Pact found in the Imperial City Sewers.

General Raetus is an Imperial and former officer in the Imperial Legion. When he refused to carry orders to slaughter a whole village of harmless Argonians, he was fired and left behind when the Legion retreated from Shadowfen. He is now the leader of the White Rose Prison and the prisoners-turned guards now found there.
General Railon is a Breton in and general of the Alessian Order who was present during the battle of Glenumbra Moors.
General Theshaga was an Orc general present during the thirty-year Siege of Orsinium. Her ghost is found during the trials at HoonDing's Watch, and is the third enemy leader encountered.

General Vette is a Breton general of the Covenant currently leading the attack on the Bal Foyen Dockyards. He is the main antagonist of both the Bleakrock Isle region and the Bal Foyen region, being responsible for the invasion of both regions.
Genevelle Lia is a Breton member of the Mages Guild found in the hall of Skywatch. She is the magister of their hall in the city.
Gentle Waters is an Argonian chef who resides in the city of Nimalten, in The Rift. She sells various food items at Gentle Dining, her stall in the Nimalten market.
Genvis Faledran is a Chimer ghost found in the Tormented Spire. He is one of the mages who first bounded Sadal to the volcano.
Georgia Matine is a Breton working at The Run Inn in Fell's Run.
Gepelem is a Breton patron of the Old Goat Inn in Alcaire Castle.
Gerent Andel was a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact. He was part of the contingent found in Ten-Maur-Wolk. His body can be found at the ruins.
Gerent Beyta was a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact. She was part of the contingent found in Ten-Maur-Wolk. Her body is found at the ruins.
Gerent Bralsi was a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact. She was part of the contingent found in Ten-Maur-Wolk. Her body can be found at the ruins.
Gerent Butheli was a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact. She was part of the contingent found in Ten-Maur-Wolk. Her body can be found at the ruins.
Gerent Hernik is a Nord soldier of the Pact attempting to make contact with the current denizens of the White Rose Prison.
Gerent Ittirma is a Nord soldier of the Pact found in the Hatching Pools.
Gerent Kepanuu is an Argonian soldier of the Pact tracking down a dangerous alchemist of the Dominion hiding in the ruins of Loriasel.
Gerent Nuleem-Malem is an Argonian soldier of the Pact tracking down a dangerous alchemist of the Dominion hiding in the ruins of Loriasel.

Gerent Saervild Steel-Wind is a Nord posing as an officer of the Ebonheart Pact on account of the Aldmeri Dominion. He was sent by his superiors to Bogmother to acquire Argonian relics for the Dominion.
Gerent Thanethen was a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact. He was part of the contingent found in Ten-Maur-Wolk. His body can be found at the ruins.
Gerent Udrasi was a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact. She was part of the contingent found in Ten-Maur-Wolk. Her body can be found at the ruins.
Gernaud Cedmain is a Breton patron of the Dusklight Inn in Hoarfrost Downs.
Geron Drothan is a Dunmer traveling wine merchant. He was ambushed by goblins of the Shadowsilk Tribe while on his way to Ebonheart.
Gessica Dercirent is a Breton priest found in the Daggerfall Cathedral.
Gethis Omobar is a Dunmer found in Stormhold. He is the husband of Eroni Omobar, a victim in the recent murders occurring in the city.
Ghain is a Nord soldier of the Ebonheart Pact. He is part of the team investigating the troubles in Kynesgrove.
Ghak gro-Urish is the Orsimer operator of the windmill in the town of Fell's Run, Rivenspire.
Ghaknag is an Orsimer residing in the city of Evermore, Bangkorai.
Ghamarguk is an Orsimer drunkard found in Daggerfall. She can be found listening to Sir Khnanya at-Salan. She has no unique dialogue.
Ghashur is an Orsimer miner. He is currently assisting the Murtag Clan in defeating the Ironhand Ogres at Shinji's Scarp in Stormhaven.
Ghatrugh is an Orsimer guild trader selling his wares at his stall, This Orc Reads Books, at the Stonetooth Fortress.

General Malgoth is a Bosmer ghost found in Dread Vullain. He was once the fearless leader of the Blackroot Clan. In his days, he won many battles and destroyed many other clans in the name of glory. He finally met his end after this conquest of Dread Vullain. He and his men fell ill after consuming the poisoned bodies of the fallen. In a last ditch attempt for survival, he sought a nearby Nereid temple for an antidote. He was turned down and then died shortly thereafter.

General Balreth was a Chimer general of the Chimeri Armed Forces during the Nede-Chimer War in the First Era. He later became one of the Brothers of Strife along with Legate Sadal when they sacrificed themselves.
Gathongor the Mauler is a Crocodile that appears in the region of Greenshade, Valenwood.
General Decianus was a General of the Imperial Legion in Hammerfell during the events of the Great War.
Ghamron is an Orsimer brewer residing in the city of Orsinium, selling drinks within its resident Fighters Guild branch.
Ghaz is an Orsimer found in The Greedy Gut in the city of Orsinium.

General Mercedene, colloquially known as the "Beast of the Reach" and later Mercedene the Cursed, is a Reachmen warlord in . She served under King Joile during the Siege of Orsinium, and assassinated Gaiden Shinji and Baloth Bloodtusk under his orders. The daughter of Evandene Tusk Collector, she slew her mother and took over leadership of the Winterborn after Evandene showed mercy to an Orc village.
Ghaturn is an Orsimer drunkard found near the Enrick's Public House in Anvil, Gold Coast.
Ghat is an Orsimer found working on the streets of Anvil, Gold Coast. She does not have any unique dialogue.
General Kyrozote is a powerful Ogrim boss found inside the Imperial City Sewers.
General Zamarchar is a powerful Grievous Twilight found inside the Nocere Oblitus of the Lambent Passage, Imperial City Sewers.
General Kora Greatstorm is a Nord officer of the Ebonheart Pact. She is found at the Skald-King's Temporary Court in Windhelm.
General Malivus is a Xivkyn general and the leader of Molag Bal's forces in the Imperial City. He can be found in the Dragonfire Cathedral. He serves as the main antagonist of .

General Pottreid was an Imperial General and commander of the Third Legion. He is said to have given the locals of Senchal a chance to surrender before he and his Legion sacked the city. It is unknown if General Pottreid survived the Aldmeri ambush at Black Rocks.
General Takar was a Redguard General of the Imperial Legion during the Umbriel Crisis.
Gathewen is an Altmer guild trader running the Sisters-In-Law Stocks along with her sister Virwen in Abah's Landing.
Gelabenn Twig-Fingers is a Bosmer bard performing at The Drowsy Owl in Hallin's Stand.
Geldaeniel is a Bosmer patron of the Dead Wolf Inn in Shornhelm.
Gelthiras is a Bosmer member of the Brackenleaf's Briars found in Brackenleaf.
General Cassel is a Breton member of the Daggerfall Covenant. She is found in Pa'alat, dealing with the Dominion traitor Krin Ren-dro.

Gennove Hinault is a Breton found hiding away from the rampaging bloodfiends with his family inside their house at their farm just outside Shornhelm. As the Vestige is out collecting weapons for them to defend themselves, the fiends managed to break in and Gennove was killed in the attack.
Geon Alinie is a Breton in . He is one of the assassination targets of the contract in Trader's Cove.
Gervaise Siniel is a Breton grocer. She sells her wares at the Bazaar in Abah's Landing.
General Noramil is a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact. He is found alongside Jorunn the Skald-King in the Circus of Cheerful Slaughter.
Ghadar is a Khajiit member of the Mages Guild. He is part of Telenger the Artificer's expedition taking place at the Falinesti Autumn Site.
Gerent Garm is a Nord soldier of the Ebonheart Pact found in Mournhold.
Gesfur is a Nord hired as a guard at the Fulstrom Homestead.
Gauldur Berard is a Breton residing in Gnisis on Vvardenfell. He used to be a worker at the Gnisis Egg Mine, but has since been caught by the disturbance in the depths of the mine.

General Valerius is an Imperial General who resided in the Imperial City during the Planemeld. He is the father of Safia Velarius. Though his death is unconfirmed, it is hearsay that he has died. If he died, it was likely by the hands of .
Ghadina is an Redguard residing in Woodhearth in the region of Greenshade.
Geniette Emard is a Breton who can be found observing arcane skirmishes in Colosseum of the Old Ways in Artaeum. She cannot be interacted with.
Gavrus Lampronius is an Imperial citizen residing in the Town.
Ghalri is a Khajiit beggar washing clothes in a pool of water near the Rimmen Wayshrine in Rimmen, Northern Elsweyr. He has no unique dialogue.
Ghamulg is an Orsimer residing on the northern shore of Lake Rumare in Cyrodiil.
General Meric Renmus is the Imperial commander of the Shields of Senchal. He can be found in Senchal Palace in Senchal with his daughter, Aeliah.

Gavros is a Dunmer daedrologist residing in Vassir-Didanat Mine in . He was hired by the owners of the mine, Malur Rethan and Benar Rethan, to conduct experiments in the newfound Daedric ruin. Specifically, he uncovered and altered a formula for a substance that turns living flesh into ebony-like material. Originally the substance was a liquid, but Gavros managed to turn it into a more potent vapour which turned out to be hard to contain, leading to an infection of the whole mine.

Geologist Rurvyn is a Dunmer researcher of the Mages Guild found in the Daedric Ruins of Ramimilk, Vvardenfell, in . She can be found taking notes north of the statue of Molag Ball. She has no unique dialogue and cannot be interacted with.
Gathelm is a Nord member of the Roister's Club encountered in the club's various chapters. His appeareance and rank are randomized.

Giovanni Civello is an Imperial Guard Captain in the Imperial City. He usually patrols the Market District and the Talos Plaza District. After Adamus Phillida retires in the quest "Permanent Retirement," Giovanni succeeds Adamus as Imperial Legion commander. After that, in an edition of the Black Horse Courier, Giovanni describes Phillida as having been his mentor and vows to continue Phillida's fight against the Dark Brotherhood.
Ghost of Alain was a Breton and one of Tiber Septim's Blades. He appears during the quest "Blood of the Divines."
Ghoragdush gro-Kashug is an Orsimer Barbarian who resides in Caldera.
Gilse Darethi is a Dunmer sorceress living in Dagon Fel, Morrowind. She is located in Sorkvild's Tower.

Gils Drelas is a Dunmer Alchemist living in Tel Branora, Morrowind. He is a member of House Telvanni. Despite being a retainer for the Telvanni, Gils will still sell alchemy supplies to anybody who visits.
Giras Indaram is a Dunmer who resides at the Armigers Stronghold in Molag Mar, Morrowind. He is a Buoyant Armiger with the Tribunal Temple who owes a debt to a House Redoran armorer in a Ald'ruhn.

Gilgondorin is an Altmer and the proprietor of the Bravil inn, Silverhome on the Water. Gilgondorin has a part in the side quest "The Forlorn Watchman." He will tell the Hero about the ghost and the Mouth of the Panther.
Gilen Norvalo is a Dunmer commoner residing in his home in the Imperial City. He is a member of the Order of the Virtuous Blood along with Grey-Throat and Seridur.

Ghola gro-Muzgol is an Orsimer and a former follower of Azura. He is part of the quest "Azura" and was laid to rest by the Hero after turning into a vampire. He was also an Afflicted Brethren. Ghola is also very well protected, sporting a full set of leveled heavy armor and a shield. He also wields a leveled axe and will also use destruction magic against the Hero. He carries the Worn, Faded Note on him.
Githriian is a Bosmer mage and criminal hiding in Hrota Cave, located north of Anvil.
Giant Spiders are creatures that appear in . They are a larger, hostile version of Spiders that appear as peaceful creatures in a number of locations.
Ghorbash the Iron Hand is an Orsimer in who lives in Dushnikh Yal, and is the brother of Chief Burguk.
Gilfre is an Imperial lumberjack residing at the Mixwater Mill in Eastmarch hold, which she also owns and operates.
Giraud Gemane is the Breton Dean of History at the Bards College in Solitude, and the author of Songs of Skyrim and Songs of Skyrim: Revised. He also teaches Speech at Master level.

Gian the Fist is an Imperial thief found in the Ratway of Riften. He is hostile to the Dragonborn and will attack them on sight. In his residence, he has an alchemy lab, cooking pot and a hay pile that is not marked as "owned."
Ghunzul is an old Orsimer warrior, who is encountered in Cracked Tusk Keep in the Falkreath Hold area of Skyrim, and is the guardian of the shards of Mehrunes' Razor.
Gissur is a Nord beggar and Thalmor informant found at the Thalmor Embassy.
Gianna is an Imperial chef in Castle Dour. She revered The Gourmet for his culinary prowess.
Gjuk is a Nord warrior in who works in the Blood Horker pirate clan under captain Stig Salt-Plank.
Ghorub gro-Ugdub is a worshipper of the Daedric Prince Malacath. He can be found at Malacath's Shrine.
Gilan Daynes is a Dunmer smith who resides in the No Name Club in the Vivec, Hlaalu Canton. He is a member of the Camonna Tong and provides trading and repair services.
Gilas Inlador is a Dunmer Sorcerer who resides in the Outer Shrine of Bal Fell. He is an evoker in the Mages Guild.

Gilmyn Andrilo is a hostile Dunmer mage and smuggler who resides in Zanabi. Gilmyn has been smuggling skooma, moon sugar and Dwarven weapons along with the other smugglers of the cave in and out of Morrowind.
Gindrala Hleran is a Dunmer commoner who resides in Ald'ruhn.
Gildan is a Bosmer nightblade, member of the Blades and trainer whom Caius Cosades secondments. She has a house in Ald'ruhn.
Gladroon is an Altmer smith and vampire who resides in vampire hideout of Ashmelech.
Ginadura Andrethi is a Dunmer Noble and member of House Hlaalu, who resides in the St. Olms Canton of Vivec.
Girvani Sedas is a Dunmer Rogue found in Vivec City, in St. Olms Plaza.

Gilyn Drobar is a Dunmer Knight, and resides in the cave of Adanumuran, in the region of the Ascadian Isles. He is hostile towards the Nerevarine. He has no weapons and fights unarmed despite very low hand-to-hand skill.
Gindas Ildram is a Dunmer Trader who resides in the Vivec, St. Olms Canton.
Girara Teran is a Dunmer Sorcerer who resides in Mallapi. She is hostile towards the Nerevarine and attacks on sight.
Giryn Nirith is a Dunmer archer and a member of a bandit gang that has occupied the Dunmer stronghold Andasreth. He can be found on the rooftop of the upper level and is hostile.
Girynu Gilnith is a Dunmer thief and slaver residing in the stronghold of Hlormaren. She is located on the top level of the stronghold's keep.
Gidar Verothan is a Dunmer commoner and one of the inhabitants of Raven Rock mining colony on the Solstheim island.
Ghorlorz gro-Moghakh is an Orsimer Warrior found inside the Daedric Ruins of Zergonipal Shrine, he will be hostile to the Nerevarine.
Giningil is a Bosmer barbarian residing in Sha-Adnius, east of Khuul.
Gih-Ja is an Argonian Slave residing in Sha-Adnius, east of Khuul.
Gilles Ronise is a Breton scholar and member of the Mages Guild found in their camp in the Glenumbra Moors, High Rock.
Gish is an Argonian Slave who resides in the slave cave of Zebabi.

Giraud Scraeg is a Breton found hiding in Chill House in Glenumbra. He says he is hiding from his Breton neighbors. Because his father was a reachman, they also think that Giraud is a cursed follower of Angof the Gravesinger.
Glamran is an Altmer enchanter residing in the Auridon city of Vulkhel Guard. He works in The Crystal Vial.
Gilradil is a Bosmer residing in Elden Root in the region of Grahtwood. She is a member of the local Mages Guild.
Girnalin is a Bosmer spinner residing in Elden Root in the region of Grahtwood. She tells stories about the Bosmeri god Y'ffre and the other metaphysics of Aurbis.
Glamion is an Altmer alchemist and proprietor of Alchemical Amalgams in Elden Root, Grahtwood.
Glanongor is a Bosmer residing in Elden Root in the region of Grahtwood.
Gladba gro-Ghol is an Orsimer residing in Aldcroft, Glenumbra. He is located inside the Aldcroft Fighters Guild.
Glalongoth is a Bosmer residing in Elden Root in the region of Grahtwood. He's a member of the local Fighters Guild.
Gjalder was a Nord and the father of Lyris Titanborn. His spirit has been taken by Molag Bal to the Foundry of Woe, where he relives his murder over and over again.
Giraud Vanne is a Breton residing on Vanne Farm, in the region of Stormhaven. He and his wife, Anais have barricaded themselves upstairs in one of the buildings on the farm.
Gianon is a Redguard armsman, residing in Alcaire Castle, at the Fighters Guild where she sells her wares.
Giraud Molose is a Breton residing in Alcaire Castle, Stormhaven. He's found outside Alcaire Keep, near the large pond.
Gierry Helane is a Breton priest residing in the city of Wayrest, Stormhaven. He is typically found in of the Temple of the Divines, where he represents the god Akatosh.
Glaras is the leader of the Brackenleaf's Briars, a group of Bosmer hunters devoted to the protection of the Brackenleaf, an ancient sentient tree.
Gindothel is a Bosmer commoner found in Bramblebreach. She enjoys pranking her brother Thragaer whom she tricked into trying to catch invisible fish in the town's stretch of water.
Gjarma Raven-Hair is Nord and the leader of the Jackdaw Pirates. Her and her men took over Haven.
Gilgoire Charmax is a character residing in the city of Camlorn.
Giniel is a Bosmer stablemaster residing in the Baandari Trading Post.
Giron Sadri is a Dunmer of House Hlaalu. He resides inside their kinhouse in Narsis. He is the one responsible for spreading the Llodos Plague in town, all on behalf of the Maulborn Cult.

Glarikha is an Orsimer and the steward of Queen Arzhela, ruler of Evermore. She is killed shortly after the Vestige helps her uncover the truth behind Duke Renchant's plans. Her body can be found not far from the former guard captain, Sir Jarnot.
Glag gro-Arzug is an Orsimer residing in the city of Sentinel, in the Alik'r Desert.
Gilles Arbogasque is a Breton commoner residing in the town of Wind Keep.
Gilen Sarandas is a Dunmer residing in the city of Windhelm.
Gil Brousseau is a Breton waiter working at the Oak and Crosier in Chorrol.
Ghobargh is an Orsimer guild trader who sells his wares at The Marbruk Mart in the city of Marbruk, Greenshade.
Ghogurz is an Orsimer guild trader selling his wares at the Windswept Stalls in Windhelm.
Ghornugag is an Orsimer found in the city of Arenthia, Reaper's March.
Giiril is a Dunmer in who resides at the Bal Foyen Dockyards.
Gil Jerine is a Breton weaponsmith selling his wares at his store, Jerine's Ironworks, in Hoarfrost Downs.
Gilbonel is a Bosmer alchemist residing in the city of Haven, Grahtwood. She can be found at her store, The Clever Retort, selling her wares.
Gilraen is a Bosmer and one of the few survivors of the daedra attack on Whisper Grove.
Ginus Maryon is a Breton patron of The Run Inn in Fell's Run. He can also be found in the Dusklight Inn, in Hoarfrost Downs.
Giorges Marck is a Breton residing at Oldgate, on Rivenspire's border with Stormhaven.
Giran is a Redguard and the keeper of the Northpoint's graveyard. He is also the husband of Nadafa, who has not been seen for quite some time.
Girnileth is a Bosmer merchant in who resides in Skywatch. She has no items for sale.

Giron Rii is a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact and the brother of Furon Rii. He is part of the team of mages investigating the presence of Chimer spirits in the Starved Plain. In the midst of the Pact's operation, Giron was lured away from the camp by agents of the Worm Cult. He was convinced with promise of great power to join their forces and thus became an enemy of the Pact.
Giruss is a Dunmer residing in the city of Riften, within the Rift.
Githiril is a Bosmer member of the Falinesti Faithful found at the Falinesti Winter Site.
Gjaki Riverwind is a Nord worshipper of Sanguine found in Sanguine's Demesne.
Gjalrunn is a Nord mystic and member of the Mages Guild. He is found at their guildhall in Alten Corimont.
Gjogni the Stump is a Nord patron of the Fish Head Tavern in Lower Yorgrim.
Gjudir the Trader is a Nord merchant found in Fort Morvunskar.
Gjudusil is a Nord leatherworker. He sells his wares at his stall, Leatherwear by Gjudusil, at the marketplace in Riften.
Glagbor gro-Uzug is an Orsimer found on the Sentinel Docks in the Alik'r Desert.
Glanir is a Bosmer soldier of the Dominion gathering information about the Crimson Raiders, a group of bandits found in the Crimson Cove.
Glanlian is a Redguard residing in the Alcaire Castle in Stormhaven.
Glardel is a Bosmer member of the Blacksap Rebellion found in Cormount.

The Ghost Adventurer is a unique subjugated ghost who can be encountered outside of Rannveig's Fast in Hjaalmarch. He is a Nord ghost under the control of Sild the Warlock. Like other Subjugated Ghosts he is not in control of his actions, and will express remorse, and apologize during battle. Unlike standard Subjugated Ghosts which are classed as bandit warriors, the Ghost Adventurer is classed as a bandit archer.
Ghornag is an Orsimer member of the Lion Guard residing in the Bangkorai Garrison, Bangkorai.
Ghorzolga is an Orsimer found in the city of Orsinium. She has no unique dialogue.
Gheshol is an Orsimer found in the city of Orsinium. She is impossible to interact with, but can be seen talking to Jorthan.
Giden Arothan is a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact. He is stationed in Fort Virak.
Ghorn is an Orsimer who can be found injured in the Graystone Quarry Depths. Ghorn is a member of the Tumnosh Clan.
Ghobub is an Orsimer miner and member of the Tumnosh Clan that can be found in the Tumnosh Clanhold near the Graystone Quarry.
Glagag gra-Khamug is an Orsimer residing in Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.
